summary: CeDeFi yield platform that announced it was closing down in December 2022 after sustained losses in its DeFi portfolio and wider 2022 market-contagion pressure.
what_happened: Midas Investments operated a centralized yield platform with DeFi strategy exposure. In late December 2022, the platform announced that it was closing down and described losses tied to its DeFi portfolio and the broader 2022 crypto downturn. This record tracks Midas as a CeDeFi yield-platform closure, not as a court-supervised bankruptcy case.
uncertainty_notes: Some closure details rely on archived official material and industry reporting. Treat repayment and balance-adjustment specifics as case-specific rather than a general bankruptcy recovery process.
notes: Added as a major 2022 CeDeFi yield-platform shutdown record.
